tools.name: find_paid_service
tools.description: Search paid x402 APIs and datasets by need. Ranked: verified first, then probe score, then price. Each result carries what you choose on: status, score (0..1), evidence_tier, paid_verified (we bought it with real USDC and it delivered), latest_purchase_delivered (false = our most recent paid purchas

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Full record for one listing id: request and response schemas, sample_query, observed 402 terms (network, payTo, scheme, x402 version), reputation detail, and paid_verification (our latest real USDC purchase, with its settlement tx where proven). Useful before paying: it shows the exact request shape

tools.name: resolve_endpoint
tools.description: Check an endpoint URL you already hold before paying it. Returns match 'active' with the listing's full record, 'delisted' (listed here, later removed), or 'unknown' (never checked here; absence is not a verdict either way). The record is dated evidence, not a safety rating. Free, read-only.
